If the Lord of Intelligence <note>original: "Buddhinatha"; the planet ruling the 5th house of the horoscope</note> is strong, or if all planets are favorable, the person becomes a giver of wisdom. If the lord of that house is situated in a "Gopura" division <note>a specific strength in the Varga system where a planet occupies its own or an exalted sign in four different divisional charts</note>, the person will be capable of profound reasoning and deliberation. || 49 ||

When the lord of the sign where the <term>Karaka</term> <note>the "significator" or planet representing a specific life area; here, Jupiter for children or Mercury for intellect</note> is placed is aspected by the Lord of the Ascendant <note>the planet ruling the rising sign</note>, and if the Lord of Speech <note>Jupiter</note> is endowed with strength, the person becomes a royal minister and a generous giver. || 50 ||

If the Lord of Intelligence is joined with the <term>Karaka</term> and placed in a "Gopura" or higher division, and if the <term>Karaka</term> is in a center or a trine <note>the 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th or 1st, 5th, 9th houses</note>, the person becomes a minister who can foresee future events. || 51 ||

When Venus is joined with Mercury and both aspect the Lord of Intelligence in a beneficial division, and if Jupiter is in its own division or a "soft" division <note>Mridu-ansha</note>, the person becomes a "Knower of the Three Times" <note>original: "Trikalajña"; one who knows past, present, and future</note>. || 52 ||

If the Lord of the 5th house <note>the house of children</note> is a masculine planet, placed in a masculine sign and a masculine division, and is in a "Gopura" division or aspected by benefits, one should know that a virtuous son will be born first; of this there is no doubt. || 53 ||

If the Lord of the 5th house is in a feminine sign, joined with a feminine planet, and in a feminine division, one should predict a daughter will be born first. If it is in the sixth division, one should predict the sixth child <note>or a child related to the 6th house themes</note>. || 54 ||

One should determine the number of children by the number of "points" <note>original: "bindu"; referring to the Ashtakavarga system of numerical strength</note> in the 5th house from the <term>Karaka</term>, excluding those points contributed by planets that are debilitated, in enemy houses, or combust <note>too close to the sun</note>. || 55 ||

One should also predict based on the "rays" <note>original: "rashmi"; a measure of planetary influence</note> of the Lord of the 5th house and the specific degree of the 5th house, or from the total rays of Jupiter according to its superior strength. || 56 ||

The friendship between the parent and child is determined by the friendship between the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the 5th house. If they are friends, there is friendship; if enemies, there is hostility; if neutral, there is a neutral relationship. || 57 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the 5th house aspect each other, or if they exchange houses or divisions, the son will be devoted to the service of the parent. || 58 ||

If the Lord of the 5th house aspects the Ascendant, or if the Lord of the 5th is placed in the Ascendant, or if the Lord of the Ascendant is in the 5th house, the son will be obedient to the parent's word. || 59 ||

If the Lord of the 5th house is in a "bad" house <note>the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses</note> even if aspected by the Lord of the Ascendant, and if it is aspected by Mars and Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note>, the son will constantly revile his father. || 60 ||

If Jupiter and Venus are in the 5th house, or if the Sun is there, or if the 5th house belongs to one of these planets...

**Thus ends the consideration of the House of Children <term>Sutabhava: the 5th house</term>.**

### Now, the Consideration of the Sixth House

The wise should describe enemies, thieves, wounds, obstacles, distress, the navel, and the abdominal region from the 6th house, as well as the six tastes <note>sweet, sour, etc.</note> and side dishes, according to the planets and signs present there. || 1 || If the lord of the 6th house is a malefic and is situated in the Ascendant <note>1st house</note> or the 8th house, it causes ulcers or scars on the body. If such a malefic planet is in the 10th house, it gives a wound on a limb, unless it is aspected by a benefic. || 2 || One should also apply this to the father and other relatives by looking at their respective houses, their lords, and their significators <term>Karaka: a planet that acts as a permanent signifier for a person or theme</term>. Experts say that by weighing the strengths and weaknesses of all these, one can predict wounds for those relatives. || 3 || The Sun and other planets represent the head, face, throat, ears, nose, private parts, hands, sides, eyes, feet, toes, and the belly respectively. || 4 || If the lord of the Ascendant, Mars, and Mercury are together in the 4th house or the 12th house, the Sages say the person will suffer from diseases of the anus or white leprosy <term>Shvitra: vitiligo or leucoderma</term>, especially if they aspect the 6th house. || 5 || If the Moon, Mercury, and the lord of the Ascendant are joined with Rahu or Ketu <note>the North and South Nodes of the Moon</note> in the body <note>the 1st house</note>, the Sages say it results in white leprosy or skin diseases <term>Kushtha: a broad term for skin ailments including leprosy</term>; however, if aspected by benefics, then...

If the planets are situated in the Ascendant <note>Lagna: the zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth</note> without the presence of the Lord of the Ascendant, the person may suffer from leprosy <note>original: "kushtha"; in historical texts, this often refers to various chronic skin diseases</note>. The great sages have declared that the results for one's father and other relatives should be determined similarly through their respective significators <term>Karaka: a planet that acts as a representative for a specific area of life</term> and the lords of the relevant houses. || 7 ||

If Mars is joined with these planets, the leprosy is of a bilious <note>pitta</note> nature; if Saturn is joined, it is caused by cold or phlegm; if the Sun is joined, it is characterized by redness of the skin. These afflictions will surely manifest in the parts of the body governed by those specific planets. || 8 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the Sixth House <note>the house of disease and enemies</note> are joined with the Sun, the person suffers from fever. If they are joined with the Moon, there is danger from water. If joined with Mars <note>original: "Kshitisunu" (Son of the Earth)</note>, there is danger from war or from eruptions and rashes <note>original: "sphota-rashi"</note>. || 9 ||

If these two lords are joined with Mercury, the disease is mental; if joined with Jupiter, the person remains free from disease <note>original: "nirvyadhika"</note>. If joined with Venus, they predict calamities for the wife; if joined with Saturn, they speak of diseases caused by "low" or "vile" wind <note>vata imbalances</note>. || 10 ||

If joined with Rahu and Ketu <note>the North and South Nodes of the Moon</note>, there is suffering from snakes, thieves, fire, or accidents caused by wind-disorders. If the Lord of the Sixth House is joined with Mercury <note>original: "Chandrasuta" (Son of the Moon)</note> and Jupiter is in the Ascendant, the person may suffer an injury to the male organ. || 11 ||

If this combination lacks the aspect <note>drishti: the "glance" or influence of a planet</note> of a benefic planet and is joined with Mars, it results from a genital disease. If the Lord of the Seventh House <note>original: "Kameshvara" (Lord of Desires)</note> is joined with Venus and placed in the Sixth House, the person's spouse is said to be sterile or impotent. || 12 ||

If the Lord of the Sixth House and the Lord of the Ascendant are both with Saturn and placed in a Quadrant <term>Kendra: the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</term> or a Trine <term>Trikona: the 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</term>, imprisonment occurs. If Rahu and Ketu are also in a Quadrant or Trine, the experts say the person will be bound in chains <note>original: "nigadam"</note>. || 13 ||

Others say the results for the father and other relatives should be judged by their respective significators and house lords. These effects manifest during the major planetary period <term>Mahadasha: the primary time-block in a person's life ruled by a specific planet</term> or the sub-period <term>Antardasha</term> of those planets. || 14 ||

If Mercury and Saturn are in the Ninth House, or if Jupiter is in the Third House, there is a risk of the hands being severed. The same applies if the Sun is in the Eighth or Twelfth House. If the Moon is in the Seventh or Eighth House, or joined with Mars and Jupiter... || 15 ||

If Rahu, Saturn, and Mercury are situated in the Tenth House, the person born will suffer the amputation of a foot <note>original: "padaccheda"</note>. If the Sun <note>original: "Divasadhinatha" (Lord of the Day)</note> is aspected by Venus and Jupiter...

If Saturn is joined with the Lord of Serpents <note>original: "Phaninatha," referring to the shadow planet Rahu</note> || 16 || or if it is placed in a cruel division of the sixty-fold chart <note>term: Shashtyamsa (a subtle 1/60th division of a sign used for fine-tuned predictions)</note>, the sages say the person's head will be severed.

When Saturn is in the Ascendant <note>term: Lagna (the rising sign at birth)</note>, Mars is in the seventh house, and the son of Venus <note>Venus</note> is in the tenth house || 17 || while the Moon is waning and placed in the seventh house, that person will have their hand or foot severed. If the Ascendant or its divisional sign is ruled by Mars, and it is occupied by the Sun and the waning Moon || 18 || while Rahu and Mercury are together and overpowered by the Sun's rays <note>term: Combustion (when a planet is too close to the sun to be seen)</note>, there will be a rupture or piercing of the abdomen.

When Saturn is rising without the aspect <note>term: Drishti (the 'glance' or influence of one planet upon another)</note> of any benefic planets, and the waning Moon is joined with Rahu and the Sun || 19 || the great sages say that for one born on the New Moon, there will be a tearing of the belly by a weapon. If the Moon is waning and aspected by Rahu, and Saturn is in the head <note>likely referring to the first house or Aries</note>, there will be a cutting of the face or head || 20 ||.

If Saturn is in the Ascendant, Mercury is in its own house, and Mercury is also in the third or fourth house, the person will be very short in stature || 21 ||. When the Moon is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house <note>note: these are the 'Dusthanas' or difficult houses of suffering</note> and is aspected by the Lord of the Ascendant, and is joined with Saturn, Gulika <note>term: Mandi/Gulika (a sensitive mathematical point considered the 'son of Saturn' and usually malefic)</note>, or Rahu, one should predict a miserable or unnatural death || 22 ||.

If Saturn is in a sign of its fall <note>term: Debilitation (the sign where a planet is weakest)</note>, or in an enemy's sign, or is "combust" <note>original: "vimudha," meaning hidden by the sun's light</note>, and is aspected by or joined with malefic planets and placed in a cruel sixty-fold division, one should predict a miserable death || 23 ||. If the lord of the eighth house <note>term: Randhresha (the Lord of the house of death)</note> is in a decanate <note>term: Drekkana (a 10-degree division of a sign)</note> known as "Pasha" (the Noose) or "Sarpa" (the Serpent), death will occur through imprisonment or hanging || 24 ||.

If the lord of the eighth house is joined with Saturn, Gulika, or Rahu, or if the son of the Sun <note>Saturn</note> is similarly placed, one should predict death by hanging || 25 ||. If the lord of the sixth or eighth house is Mars, or if it is joined with the lord of the third house, and is further joined with Saturn, Gulika, or Rahu in a cruel division, death occurs in battle || 26 ||.

One should predict death by war if the lord of the decanate is joined with Saturn, and is aspected by or joined with Mars, or is in a sign or division ruled by Mars || 27 ||. When the Sun and Mars aspect each other, or if they are placed in each other's signs or divisions, one should predict death resulting from a duel or hand-to-hand combat || 28 ||.

If many malefic planets are located in the eighth house <note>the house of death and longevity</note> in the divisional signs of Mars, and are joined with a cruel sixtieth division <note>original: "krura-shashtyansha," a specific subtle division of a zodiac sign associated with harsh outcomes</note>, one should predict immediate death. || 29 ||

If all the benefic planets are in their signs of depression, combustion <note>too close to the sun</note>, or in enemy houses, and are defeated in planetary war, or if they reside in malefic divisions and are joined by malefic planets, one should predict his immediate death. || 30 ||

Immediate death occurs if Saturn, Rahu, and the Sun are all aspected <note>glanced at</note> by the Lord of the Eighth House, and are in cruel divisions or in a state of combustion. || 31 ||

When the Sun is in the house of disease <note>the sixth house</note>, and that house is joined by malefic planets or aspected by them, one should predict a wound or ulcer arising from an excess of bile <note>original: "paittika," relating to the Pitta dosha in Ayurveda</note>. || 32 ||

If the Moon is similarly situated and aspected by cruel planets in its division, the person born will be afflicted by wind diseases <note>original: "vata," relating to the Vata dosha</note>; if Mars is so situated, he is afflicted by blood-bile disorders <note>original: "rakta-pitta," often manifesting as internal bleeding or skin eruptions</note>. || 33 ||

If Mercury is so situated, he is especially afflicted by phlegm and wind disorders <note>original: "shleshma-vata"</note>; if Jupiter, an internal abscess <note>original: "vidradhi"</note> should be predicted; if Venus, urinary diseases or dysentery. || 34 ||

If Saturn is so situated, there is especially a chronic enlargement of the spleen or abdominal tumor <note>original: "gulma-roga"</note>; if joined with Rahu or Ketu <note>the north and south nodes of the moon</note>, an affliction by spirits or demonic possession <note>original: "baadha paishachiki"</note> is remembered. || 35 ||

If the Moon is in the sixth house joined with Mars, the person suffers from diseases such as mental confusion or boils; if the Moon is with the Sun in a sign of Mars, he suffers from erysipelas <note>a skin infection</note> and colic pain. || 36 ||

If Mars is in the sixth house joined with Mercury and aspected by Venus and the Moon, and is joined with cruel divisions, they say the person will indeed suffer from consumption <note>original: "kshaya-roga," often referring to tuberculosis</note>. || 37 ||

If Saturn and Mars are in the sixth house aspected by the Sun and Rahu, and the Lord of the Ascendant is weak in strength, the man will be chronically ill. || 38 ||

If Saturn is in the sixth house with an abdominal tumor and is aspected by the Sun, Mars, or Rahu, and is not aspected or joined by benefics, he will suffer from asthma, cough, and consumption. || 39 ||

If the Moon is in a watery sign and the Lord of the Sixth House is also in a watery sign and aspected by Mercury, urinary difficulty <note>original: "mutrakrichhra"</note> and related ailments will occur. || 40 ||

If the Moon is in the sixth house, Saturn in the eighth, a malefic in the twelfth, and the Lord of the Ascendant is joined with malefic divisions, he will contract the disease of chronic congestion or sinusitis <note>original: "pinasa"</note>—

### Now, the Consideration of the Seventh House

From the "Youthful" house <note>The 7th house, often called the *Yuvati Bhava*</note>, one should judge marriage, the wife or husband, yogurt, jaggery, and milk. One should also speak of arrivals and departures, the attainment of desire, the urinary bladder, and lost wealth. || 1 ||

If Venus is in the house of the spouse, the person will be very lustful; if Mercury is there, they are devoted to others' spouses; if Jupiter is there, they are devoted to their own spouse. If the Son of the Sun <note>Saturn</note> is there, they are pleased with a wicked spouse, but if the Lord of the house is well-placed, they have a good spouse. || 2 ||

If Mars is present, the person is fond of many women and brings ruin to the family; if the Sun is present, they are a family man but attached to many spouses. If the lords of the Ascendant, the house of wealth, and the house of the spouse are joined with Venus and associated with malefic planets, || 3 || the person born is devoted to others' spouses and follows a wicked path; however, if these are aspected by benefics, this will not be the case. If the lords of the Ascendant and the house of enemies are joined with malefics, the person is devoted to others' spouses and follows a wicked path. || 4 ||

If the lord of the Ascendant and the lords of the houses of enemies and wealth are joined with malefics, or if they are in the sign of the spouse, or if the lord of the spouse is with Saturn and a malefic, the person born is devoted to others' spouses within the family. || 5 ||

If the lord of the spouse is with Rahu or Ketu <note>The North and South Nodes of the Moon</note> or aspected by a malefic, there is a "Yoga of Adultery" <note>A planetary combination suggesting infidelity</note>. If the lords of the house of actions, the house of wealth, and the house of the spouse are situated in the house of honor, they declare the person a paramour. || 6 ||

If even one of these planets is in the fourth sign, the person born goes after others' spouses. If the lord of the house of children and the <term>lord of the spouse</term> <note>original: "darapatau"; the planet ruling the 7th house</note> are strong but aspected by or joined with the lord of the house of enemies, || 7 || the person born is childless, or if the spouse is aspected by a benefic planet, there may be a son from a paramour. If the lord of the spouse is with a malefic in the house of wealth and aspected by Mars, there is a <term>son of a paramour</term> <note>original: "jaraputrah"; a child born of an extramarital union</note>. || 8 || If the <term>lords of the houses of intellect and dharma</term> <note>original: "dhidharmanathau"; the lords of the 5th and 9th houses</note> along with the lord of the spouse are in "bad places" <note>original: "duhsthana"; the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses</note>, weak in strength, but the son is aspected by a benefic...

# On the Strength of the Seventh House

In the section regarding strength: If the planet is in a "soft" division <note>original: "mridu-amsha"; a specific auspicious subdivision of a zodiac sign</note> and occupies a "Gopura" division <note>a high-ranking dignity where a planet resides in its own or exalted sign in four specific divisional charts</note>, the person born will be endowed with two hundred women. || 34 ||

If the lord of the sign where the ruler of the significator's <term>Karaka: the planet representing a specific life area; for marriage, this is usually Venus</term> navamsha <note>a 1/9th sub-division of a sign</note> is placed, is located in a quadrant <term>Kendra: the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses of a horoscope</term>, and is in a soft division and a Gopura division, one should declare that the person born will have three hundred wives. || 35 ||

If the planet is in a cruel division <note>kruramsage</note>, she might even give poison to her husband, be harsh, and subject to public scandal. **58**

When the Lord of the Spouse is positioned near the Lord of the Ascendant <term>Lagnanatha: the planet ruling the self/first house</term>, they say marriage occurs in childhood. If a benefic planet is in a sign close to the Ascendant or the house of the spouse, the result is the same. **59**

If the Ascendant, the house of family <note>Kutumba</note>, or the house of the spouse are occupied by benefics or associated with auspicious divisions, and their lords are aspected by benefics, the noble sages say marriage and such events occur in childhood. **60**

When the Lord of the Spouse is in a high dignity such as *Paravatansha* <note>a specific high-ranking astrological division</note>, and the Lord of the Family is strong, and the Lord of the Ascendant is in a "soft" division <note>mrdvakhya-bhage</note>, the Munis <note>ancient sages</note> declare marriage occurs in childhood. **61**

They say fortune <note>Bhagya</note> comes after marriage if Venus is setting or in a house of increase <note>Upachaya: the 3rd, 6th, 10th, or 11th houses</note>, or if the Lord of the Family is in such a position, or if the Lord of the Ascendant is joined with or aspected by a benefic. **62**

If the significator <term>Karaka: the planet representing a specific life area; for marriage, usually Venus</term>, the Lord of the Spouse, the Lord of the Family, and the Lord of the Ascendant are all in difficult houses <note>6th, 8th, or 12th</note>, or in debilitation, or in an enemy's sign, or eclipsed, or with malefics, then fortune is destroyed after marriage. **63**

Even if associated with a cruel sixtieth-division <note>shashtyansha</note>, if the significator or such a leading planet is joined with a benefic or receives an auspicious aspect, then after an initial loss, the person attains fortune. **64**

If a malefic is joined with the Lord of the Spouse in a trine <note>Trikona: the 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</note>, or if the significator is joined with a malefic, or if these are in the house of family or the house of honor <note>Mana: the 10th house</note>, the wise say marriage occurs at a distance <note>or after a long delay/dispute</note>. **65**

If there is a malefic in the house of honor, or in the house of family, or in the house of fortune, or if a malefic is in the house of the spouse in a cruel division...

If the <term>aspect</term> <note>The "glance" or influence of one planet upon another</note> of a cruel planet falls upon the relevant house, or if the planet is far removed, the wise say this indicates a delay or difficulty in marriage. (66) This same method should be applied to the houses concerning children and other matters; after contemplating the planetary spread, one should speak regarding sons and others. If the Lord of the Seventh House <note>The "Kalatra-natha," the planet ruling the house of marriage</note> is weaker than the Lord of the Ascendant <note>The "Lagneśvara," the planet ruling the rising sign</note>, and is located in a hostile division or is combust, (67) or is in a debilitated sign or associated with lowly planets, then the spouse will be obtained from a lower social status.

If the Lord of the Seventh House is stronger than the Lord of the Ascendant, is in a favorable division, and is joined with a favorable aspect, (68) or is in a special <term>Vaisheshika</term> division <note>A specific high-quality planetary strength in Vedic astrology</note> or in its highest exaltation, then the spouse will be obtained from an excellent or higher social status. If the Lord of the Ascendant is weak and the Lord of the Seventh House is with a malefic planet or in a debilitated position, (69) or is in a descending state, the person themselves is of lower status than the family of the spouse.

Therefore, if the Lord of the Ascendant is powerful, in an ascending state, or in its highest exaltation, (70) and is located in a <term>Kendra</term> or <term>Trikona</term> <note>The "angular" or "trinal" houses, considered the most powerful and auspicious positions in a birth chart</note> with a gentle planet, then the person is of higher status than their spouse. One should judge this from the Lord of the Seventh House, the sign of the spouse, or the Lord of the Second House <note>The house of family and wealth</note>. (71)

If the strengths are equal, they say the couple is of the same social class, and the woman will be of good character and devoted to her husband. If the Lord of the Seventh House is an enemy to the Lord of the Ascendant, then the spouse's family will be hostile. (72) If the Lord of the Ascendant is a friend to the other, then the family members born of that lineage are friends. If the Lord of the Seventh is an enemy to the Lord of the Ascendant, then the relatives are enemies; otherwise, they are different. (73)

One should determine the caste or color of the spouse from the Lord of the Seventh House, the sign itself, or the <term>Karaka</term> <note>The "significator" planet, usually Venus for marriage</note>. Among these, the one with the greatest strength should be pointed out. (74) If that planet is aspected by Jupiter, the spouse will be virtuous and endowed with beauty. If aspected by or joined with a malefic planet, the spouse will be of poor appearance and bad character. (75) The great sages say the sign occupied by the Lord of the Seventh House is the birth sign of the spouse. Its exaltation, debilitation, or the three divisions of that sign...

### On the Nature of Unions

If the Sun is in the seventh house <note>the house of partnerships</note>, there is a union with a barren woman; if the Moon is there, the women are like maidservants. With Mars in the seventh, there is union with a woman during her menses, or it is said to be a union with a barren woman. || 79 || With Mercury, it is said to be a prostitute, a woman of no means, or the wife of a merchant. With Jupiter, it would be the wife of a priest <note>original: "Brahmana"</note>. With Venus <note>original: "Bhrugu"</note>, there is union with a pregnant woman. || 80 || With Saturn or Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note>, the woman may be of low status or in her menses. With Rahu specifically, union with a pregnant woman is noted; with Saturn, it is with a dark-complexioned or hunchbacked woman. || 81 || Thus, by the placement of these planets in the fourth house <note>the house of "Sukha" or happiness/home</note>, such unions with women should be inferred. From the Sun and other planets located in the fourth house, one should also determine matters regarding vehicles and the home. || 82 ||

### On Dwellings and Behavior

The dwelling may be a forest, a house, a mud wall, a place of recreation, or a temple. It could also be a place of water, or a stable for horses and elephants; thus should the location be determined. || 83 || If the four angular houses <term>Kendra: the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</term> are joined by malefic planets <note>planets like Mars or Saturn</note>, one should predict intercourse like that of four-legged animals. If all the angular houses are aspected by malefics, the same should be declared. || 84 || If the angular or trinal houses are joined by malefics, one should predict intercourse like a beast. If Saturn is joined by malefics, or in the division of Saturn, one says the same. || 85 || If Saturn and the Sun are in the fourth house and Mars is present, one predicts intercourse like a beast. If Rahu or Mars is in the seventh or fourth house, such intercourse is predicted. || 86 || If the lord of the seventh house is aspected by Venus, or is in a sign ruled by Mars, or is joined with Venus, the person will engage in oral-genital contact <note>original: "Bhagachumbana": literally, kissing the vulva</note>. || 87 || Likewise, through the lord of the second house <note>the house of family/mouth</note>, one becomes a practitioner of such acts. If the lord of the tenth house is aspected by Saturn and is in a sign ruled by Mars—

If the Lord of the Seventh House <note>the planet ruling the house of marriage</note> is situated in a "dry" sign, or is associated with a dry planet, one should predict that the private parts of the spouse will be dry <note>lacking in natural lubrication or vitality</note>. || 1 || If the Lord of the Seventh is in a sign ruled by a malefic <note>harmful</note> planet, or is hemmed in between malefics, or is associated with or aspected by malefics, one should likewise predict dryness in the private parts. || 2 ||

If many malefics are in the seventh, sixth, or eighth houses, and are associated with cruel sixtieth-divisions, one should predict urinary diseases <note>specifically *mutrakricchra*, or painful/difficult urination</note>. || 110 || Thus, the certain and varied results of the Seventh House have been declared by me, the wise Venkatesa. || 11 ||

Even in that case, if there is a specific conjunction involving the <term>Lord of the Ascendant</term><note>Lagnesha: The planet ruling the first house of the zodiac at the time of birth</note>, the wise say this person will have a short life. **(2)** If the <term>Lord of the Eighth House</term><note>Randhranatha: The eighth house governs death and longevity</note> is situated in its own sign, the great sages declare the person will have a long life. One should also specifically consider longevity through Saturn <note>Mandena: A name for the planet Saturn, the significator of lifespan</note> when it is placed in its own sign, a friendly sign, or its sign of exaltation. **(3)**

If the Lord of the Ascendant is conjoined with the Lord of the Eighth House, or if it is placed in the sixth or twelfth houses, or if the lords of the sixth and twelfth houses are in the Ascendant—provided they are aspected by benefic planets—one should declare a long life for him. **(4)** One should also consider longevity through the <term>Lord of the Tenth House</term><note>Karmeshvara: The planet ruling the house of action and profession</note>; if it is in a friendly sign or exalted, life is long. Likewise, they describe long life when the Lords of the Tenth, the Ascendant, and the Eighth are all situated in <term>quadrants</term><note>Kendra: The 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses, considered the pillars of a horoscope</note>. This is also said to occur when three celestial planets, including Saturn, are in quadrants. **(5)**

When the Lord of the Ascendant is in a quadrant, conjoined with Jupiter and Venus, or aspected by them, one should predict a long life. **(6)** The noble-minded sages say that long life is especially indicated when planets are in their own signs or <term>trines</term><note>Kona: The 1st, 5th, and 9th houses</note>. **(7)** When the <term>four corners</term><note>Chaturasre: Referring to the 4th and 8th houses</note> are occupied by benefics, the Lord of the Ascendant is joined with a benefic, and there is an aspect from Jupiter, one should predict a full lifespan. **(8)**

If the malefic planets are in the third, sixth, or eleventh houses, while the benefics are in quadrants or trines, and the Lord of the Ascendant is endowed with strength, one should predict a full lifespan. **(9)** When benefic planets are present in the sixth, seventh, and eighth houses, and malefics are in the third, sixth, and eleventh, one should predict a full lifespan. **(10)** If the Lord of the Eighth is in the Ascendant, conjoined with or aspected by Jupiter and Venus, and the Lord of the Ascendant is in a quadrant, one should predict a long life. **(11)**

If three planets are in their signs of exaltation, the Lord of the Eighth is in the Ascendant, and the eighth house is free from malefics, one should predict a long life. **(12)** If three planets are in the eighth house while in their exaltation, friendly, or own signs, and the Lord of the Ascendant is strong, one should predict a long life. **(13)** If all malefics and benefics are in the <term>Paravata</term><note>A specific high-quality division (varga) in planetary strength calculations</note> or similar auspicious divisions, and are in a quadrant—

If the lords of the houses are situated in the trines <note>The 1st, 5th, and 9th houses, considered the most auspicious positions in a birth chart</note>, one should predict a full life span. || 14 || If the lord of the Ascendant <note>Lagnēśa: the planet ruling the rising sign</note> is weak and malefic planets are placed in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses, and if there is an absence of any aspect or conjunction from benefic planets, the person will have a short life or be childless. || 15 || If the lord of the eighth house <note>Randhrēśa: the house of death and longevity</note> or Saturn <note>original: "Bhānuja" (son of the Sun)</note> is in a cruel division <note>Krūra-ṣaṣṭyaṃśaka: a specific 1/60th division of a sign associated with harsh results</note>, or is associated with or aspected by malefics, one should predict a very short life. || 16 ||

If malefic planets are placed in the quadrants <note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</note> without any aspect from benefics, and the lord of the Ascendant is devoid of strength, one should predict a very short life. || 17 || If the twelfth and second houses are joined by malefics and lack the aspect of benefics, or if they fall in a cruel division, one should predict a very short life. || 18 ||

The combinations for longevity are said to be of three kinds: short, medium, and long life. Short life is up to thirty-two years; after that, it is medium life. || 19 || Up to seventy years is medium, and beyond that, they say, is a full life span. If the lord of the Ascendant is an enemy to the Sun <note>original: "Dinanātha" (Lord of the Day)</note>, it indicates a short life. || 20 || If there is neutrality between them, it is medium life; if they are friends, one should predict a long life. If the lord of the Ascendant is weak, but Jupiter <note>original: "Jīva"</note> is in a quadrant or a trine, and malefics are in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses, medium life is declared. || 21-22 ||

If benefics are in the quadrants or trines and Saturn is endowed with strength, even if malefics are in the sixth or eighth, medium life is declared. || 22 || If there is a mixture of influences in the Ascendant, trines, or quadrants, it results in medium life. || 23 || For those born with short-life combinations, the period <note>Dasha: a planetary time cycle</note> of the "Vipat" <note>The 3rd star/constellation from the birth star, associated with misfortune</note> brings death. In medium life, the "Pratyari" period <note>The 5th star from the birth star, associated with opposition</note> especially grants death. || 24 || The period of the "Vadha" lord <note>The 7th star from the birth star, associated with execution/death</note> is difficult for those with long-life combinations. Having determined the longevity in this way, the wise astrologer should speak to the seeker. || 25 ||

If the lords of the Ascendant and the house of longevity are devoid of strength and are joined with Mars <note>original: "Dharāsūnu" (Son of the Earth)</note> or the lord of injuries, those who know the science say death will occur in battle, or specifically, death by a weapon. || 26 ||

If the lords of the eighth house <note>the house of death</note> and the ascendant <note>the house of self/body</note> are situated in the sixth house <note>the house of enemies and illness</note>, or are associated with Rahu, Ketu, or Saturn, then during the sub-period or the major planetary period <term>Vipaka</term><note>the fruition of a planetary cycle</note> of these planets, the person meets their end through weapons or thieves. || 27 ||

If the waning Moon is in the eighth house and joined with Mars or Saturn, or is otherwise poorly placed, death occurs from the fear and complications of epilepsy.

->**A Few Combinations for Misfortune**<-

If a malefic planet is in the tenth house from the Ascendant <note>original: "Lagna"</note> and Mars <note>original: "Bhumiputra," literally 'Son of the Earth'</note> is aspected by malefics, they say the maternal uncle will die. ### Now, the Consideration of the Tenth House

From the tenth house, one should indicate inclination, command, fame, rain, travel, pious works, honor, action <note>Karma</note>, livelihood, and the knees. || 1 || Those learned in this science say that if the lord of the tenth house <note>Karmesha</note> is weak and joined with malefic planets, there will be a deficiency in one's actions. If the lord of the tenth, Jupiter, and Mercury are endowed with strength, the person will perform sacrifices <note>Yajnas</note>. || 2 || If these planets are aspected by benefics and possess strength, they say the person will perform special sacrifices. ### Regarding the Yoga for Renunciation

If the Lord of the Tenth is accompanied by four planets situated in trines or angles, the person is liberated. When four planets are positioned in the angles <note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</note>, the person attains <term>Pravrajya</term> <note>The state of wandering as an ascetic or monk</note>; so it has been declared by the lords of the sages. || 1 || If the Lord of the Ascendant is not aspected by other planets but aspects the Son of the Sun <note>Saturn</note>, or if the Son of the Sun aspects the Lord of the Ascendant, a Yoga for Renunciation <note>original: "Sannyasa Yoga"</note> exists, though it is weak in strength. || 2 || If the Moon <note>original: "Kumudatmabandhu", friend of the lotus</note> is in a decan <note>A ten-degree division of a sign</note> of Saturn and is aspected by Saturn, they say such a yoga occurs. Likewise, if the Moon is in a division of Saturn or Mars and is aspected by Saturn. || 3 || If the lord of the Renunciation Yoga is with Rahu <note>The North Node of the Moon</note>, or in a cruel division, or joined with <term>Gulika</term> <note>A mathematical point in the sky considered malefic in Vedic astrology</note>, they describe a defect in the renunciation; if it is devoid of benefic influences, there will be a total break or failure of the vow. || 4 || Thus ends the section on the Tenth House of Action.

From the <term>House of Expenditure</term><note>Sanskrit: Vyaya-bhava; the 12th house in a horoscope, traditionally associated with loss, waste, and liberation</note>, one should determine all forms of spending, a fall into hell, and physical impairments. A wise person should also designate the left eye, the pair of feet, and the place of sleep from this house. || 1 ||

When the House of Expenditure is joined by a malefic planet, and its lord is a malefic planet, and it is aspected by a malefic planet, wealth is spent on sinful or harmful causes. || 2 ||

If the House of Expenditure or its lord is joined by Saturn, <term>Gulika</term><note>A "shadow planet" or mathematical point in Vedic astrology considered highly malefic</note>, or Mandi, and is situated in a cruel <term>divisional sign</term><note>Sanskrit: Amshaka; a specific subdivision of a zodiac sign used for fine-tuned analysis</note>, wealth is spent on sinful causes. || 3 ||

If the lord of the House of Expenditure is in a favorable <term>Ninth Division</term><note>Sanskrit: Navamsha; the most important divisional chart in Indian astrology</note>, is in a benefic division, and is placed between benefic planets, wealth is spent on righteous or religious causes. || 4 ||

If Jupiter and Venus, or Mercury and the Moon, are in the House of Expenditure and are aspected by benefics, or are placed in the <term>Paravata</term><note>A specific high-quality dignity or "varga" indicating great strength and auspiciousness</note> divisions, wealth is spent on righteous causes. || 5 ||

If the lord of the House of Expenditure is in a <term>Trine</term><note>The 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</note> or a <term>Quadrant</term><note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</note> but is aspected by a malefic or is in a cruel <term>sixtieth division</term><note>Sanskrit: Shashtyamsa; a very subtle division of a sign</note>, wealth is spent on sinful causes. || 6 ||

If the lord of the House of Expenditure is aspected by or joined with a malefic <term>Lord of Action</term><note>Sanskrit: Karma-natha; the ruler of the 10th house of career and public deeds</note>, and is in an enemy's sign or a sign of debilitation, wealth is spent on sinful causes. || 7 ||

If the lord of the House of Expenditure is aspected by or joined with a benefic Lord of Action, and is in its own sign of exaltation or a friendly division, wealth is spent on righteous causes. || 8 ||

If the lord of the House of Expenditure is weak, or is joined/aspected by the lord of the <term>House of Enemies</term><note>The 6th house</note>, or is joined with Gulika and others, wealth is spent due to enemies. || 9 ||

If the lord of the House of Expenditure is joined or aspected by a weak <term>Lord of the Spouse</term><note>Sanskrit: Dara-natha; the ruler of the 7th house</note> or is in a cruel division, there is loss of wealth because of a woman. || 10 ||

If the lord of the House of Expenditure is similarly joined or aspected by Mars in such a state, there is loss of wealth because of a brother. || 11 ||

If joined or aspected by a weak <term>Lord of the House of Children</term><note>Sanskrit: Putra-bhava-ishvara; the ruler of the 5th house</note> and the lord of the House of Expenditure is in a cruel division, wealth is spent because of a son. || 12 ||

If the lord of the House of Expenditure is joined or aspected by the <term>Lord of the House of the Father</term><note>The 9th or 10th house depending on the system</note> or the <term>Significator</term><note>Sanskrit: Karaka; the planet that naturally represents a person or category, in this case, the Sun for the father</note> of the father, wealth is spent because of the father. || 13 || In the same way, through connection with the mother... <note>The text cuts off here, likely continuing with the mother's significators on the next page.</note>

When the Lord of the 12th House <note>the house of expenditure and loss</note> is aspected by or associated with cruel planets <note>malefics like Mars or Saturn</note> and occupies a cruel division of the zodiac, wealth will be spent on account of one's mother. **14** If the Lord of the 12th is weak, or occupies a sign or division ruled by a cruel planet, or is in its sign of debilitation <note>the zodiac sign where a planet is weakest</note>, one should predict physical infirmity or deformity. **15** When many malefic planets join together in the 12th house or with its lord, and are further joined by Saturn or <term>Mandya</term> <note>a sensitive mathematical point in the sky considered malefic</note>, physical deformity should be predicted. **16**

Consider the stronger of the Sun and Moon; the ruler of the <term>Drekkana</term> <note>a 10-degree division of a sign</note> occupied by that stronger luminary determines the soul's destination. If that ruler is Jupiter, the soul goes to the realm of the Gods; if the Moon or Venus, to the realm of the Ancestors; if the Sun or Mars, to the realm of animals; if Mercury or Saturn, to the hellish realms. **20-21** These destinations are described in order, and the realm is said to be "excellent" if the planet is exalted <note>in its strongest position</note>. **21** If the planet is in its highest exaltation, the soul reaches a superior realm; if debilitated, it reaches a lowly state; if in a neutral position, the result is mediocre—so say the <term>Maharishis</term> <note>Great Sages</note>. **22**

If a benefic planet is in its exaltation or in the 12th house, aspected by gentle planets <note>benefics like Jupiter or Venus</note>, or occupies a division belonging to the realm of the Gods, the attainment of <term>Svarga</term> <note>Heaven or a celestial paradise</note> will occur. **23** If Jupiter is the Lord of the 10th house <note>house of action/karma</note> or is placed in the 12th house and is aspected by a benefic planet, the attainment of Heaven will occur. **24** If the Lord of the Eyes <insert>1. # Now the Chapter on Royal Yogas is Spoken.

With six planets in their signs of exaltation, one becomes a King of Kings and the ruler of many lands. With five planets exalted and Jupiter in the ascendant, one becomes a king endowed with great power. || 1 || If the ascendant is Aquarius or if Venus is in its exaltation, and four planets are exalted—provided they are not in their signs of debilitation or in the "cruel" sixtieth divisions <term>shashty-amsha</term>—one becomes a lord of the earth. || 2 || If the ascendant is Taurus and the Moon is placed there, and six other planets are in exaltation, one becomes a king. If all planets are in their own signs or in exaltation in any house, one is born equal to a king. || 3 || If planets are in their "root-trine" <term>mula-trikona</term> signs, or in the signs of friends, or are retrograde; and if one planet is exalted in any house while the rest are not in debilitated divisions, one is born equal to a king. || 4 || Even a single exalted planet, if aspected by a friend, produces a king; if joined with a friend, it brings great wealth and success. Those who are without wealth, without happiness, foolish, diseased, imprisoned, or burdened by sins and suffering, are those whose planets are in enemy signs or debilitated...

...in moments. ||5|| A birth is auspicious when it occurs in a <term>Vargottama</term><note>The best division; when a planet occupies the same sign in both the main birth chart and the ninth divisional chart, increasing its strength.</note> position, or when a benefic planet is in the <term>Veshi-sthana</term><note>The second house from the Sun.</note>, or when the <term>Kendras</term><note>The angular houses: 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th, which represent the pillars of life.</note> are not empty, and when the planets known as <term>Karaka</term><note>Significators or functional planets that produce specific results.</note> are present. ||6||

Excluding the Sun, the planetary combinations known as <term>Sunapha</term>, <term>Anapha</term>, and <term>Durudhara</term> are formed when planets (other than the Sun) are situated in the second, the twelfth, or both houses from the Moon, respectively. Otherwise, many say the <term>Kemadruma</term><note>A combination often associated with poverty or lack of support, occurring when no planets are flanking the Moon.</note> yoga is formed. However, others say <term>Kemadruma</term> is not considered to exist if the Moon is in a <term>Kendra</term> or is joined by another planet. Some say this applies to the <term>Navamsha</term><note>The ninth divisional chart.</note> positions as well, but those views are not widely accepted. ||7||

When benefic planets are in the sixth, seventh, and eighth houses from the Moon, it is called <term>Adhi-yoga</term>. One born under this becomes a commander, a minister, or a king. Such people are born with abundant happiness and wealth, they destroy their enemies, live long lives, and are free from the fear of disease. ||8||

If the Moon is in the Ascendant, Jupiter is in the fourth house, and Venus is in the tenth house, while Saturn is in its own sign or its sign of exaltation, that man becomes equal to a king. ||9||

If benefic planets are situated in the tenth, eleventh, twelfth, second, and third houses, that man becomes equal to a king. ||10||

If the benefics are in the <term>Kendras</term> or <term>Trikonas</term><note>The trinal houses: 1st, 5th, and 9th, representing grace and fortune.</note>, and the malefic planets are in the sixth, eleventh, and third houses, and the Lord of the Ascendant is strong, that man becomes equal to a king. ||11||

If Jupiter is aspected by or joined with Mercury, then other kings will carry out his commands upon their heads <note>A metaphor for total obedience and respect.</note>. ||12||

If a planet is in its <term>Nicha-sthita</term><note>Debilitation; its weakest state.</note> at birth, but the lord of that sign or the lord of its exaltation sign is in a <term>Kendra</term> from the Ascendant, he becomes a king who is a <term>Dharmika-chakravartti</term><note>A righteous universal emperor who rules according to sacred law.</note>. ||13||

If the Moon is in a <term>Kendra</term> (excluding the Ascendant) and is in a <term>Trikona</term> aspected by Jupiter, and also aspected by a strong Venus, the man born is equal in fortune to a lord of the earth. ||14||

The great planets that are in their debilitated signs at birth, but are in their exalted <term>Amsha</term><note>Divisional positions.</note>, bring fortune equal to a king. Conversely, even if planets are in their exalted signs, if they are in their debilitated <term>Amsha</term>, they do not produce such fortune. ||15|| Planets endowed with strength...

# Chapter 9

<margin>S. Chi. <note>Abbreviation for the source text, likely "Sarvartha Chintamani."</note></margin> If the planets are situated in their signs of exaltation within the first six houses, a king is born in the first half of life. If they are instead located in the western half <note>the latter six houses</note>, or if they are mixed between both, then fortune arises in those respective periods. || 16 ||

Wise men say that the span of a human life should be divided into three parts. If <term>benefic planets</term> <note>planets like Jupiter, Venus, or a strong Moon that bring positive influence</note> are placed in the houses starting from the twelfth <note>the first segment of the life-cycle in this system</note>, they grant auspicious results in the first portion of life. || 17 ||

If many benefics are so placed in the second segment, happiness comes then; likewise for the third segment. However, in whichever segment many <term>malefic planets</term> <note>planets like Mars or Saturn that bring challenges</note> are found—especially if they are in their signs of debilitation or are "combust" <note>hidden by the glare of the Sun</note>— || 18 ||

In that period, there will be suffering, and specifically, a fall from one's position or kingdom is predicted. Conversely, with the presence of noble "lords of the sky" <note>planets</note> in these segments, they declare a time of great beauty and success. || 19 ||

When Jupiter is in the <term>Ascendant</term> <note>Lagna; the sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth</note> and Mercury is in a <term>Cardinal house</term> <note>Kendra; the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</note>, and they are aspected by the Lord of Fortune <note>the ruler of the 9th house</note>, or if the Lord of the Ascendant aspects them, that man becomes equal to a king. || 20 ||

If Jupiter is in the seventh house or in a <term>Trine</term> <note>Trikona; the 5th or 9th houses</note>, and is aspected by the Lord of the Ascendant, that man becomes equal to a king. || 21 ||

When Saturn is in a Cardinal house or a Trine, situated in its sign of exaltation or its <term>Root-Trine</term> <note>Moolatrikona; a specific sign position where a planet is particularly strong</note>, and is aspected by the Lord of the Kingdom <note>the ruler of the 10th house</note>, he will possess the honors of a king. || 22 ||

If the Lord of Actions <note>10th house ruler</note> is in the eighth house but occupies a division of exaltation or a friendly sign, or is in the <term>Paravata division</term> <note>a high-quality planetary strength grade</note>, that man becomes a king of kings. || 23 ||

Even if Jupiter is debilitated in the Ascendant, or if the Lord of Dharma <note>9th house ruler</note> is in the eighth house, if they occupy such auspicious divisions <note>as mentioned above</note>, that man becomes a king of kings. || 24 ||

With Jupiter in the twelfth, Saturn in the eleventh, and the Sun as the Lord of Valor <note>3rd house ruler</note>; or with Jupiter in the twelfth and the Lord of the Ascendant present, one becomes a king of kings. || 25 ||

If Jupiter is in the fifth house, the Moon is in a Cardinal house, and Jupiter is also in a Cardinal house; and if the Ascendant is a "fixed" sign and its Lord is in the house of the Kingdom <note>10th house</note>, he shall be a king. || 26 ||

In whose birth all planets stand in the first six houses, or if the Lord of Fortune is in the house of wealth <note>2nd house</note> along with the Moon...

...he shall become a king. || 27 || When the lord of the sign or the <term>Navamsha</term><note>A one-ninth division of a zodiac sign, used for fine-tuning astrological strength</note> occupied by the Moon is placed in a <term>Kendra</term><note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses; the "pillars" of a chart</note> or a <term>Trikona</term><note>The 1st, 5th, or 9th houses; considered very auspicious</note>, or if it is in a Kendra from Mercury, that man becomes a king of kings. || 28 || If the Moon is with Mars in the second or third house, and Rahu <note>The North Node of the Moon</note> is in the fifth house, that man becomes a king of kings. || 29 || If the lord of the <term>Navamsha</term> occupied by the lord of the ninth house is in the fourth or fifth house, that man becomes a supreme king. || 30 || If the lords of the houses of action <note>the 10th house</note> are cruel <note>malefic planets like Mars or Saturn</note> and planets are placed sequentially in the first six houses starting from the Ascendant, that man becomes a king of kings. || 31 || If the Ascendant is in a <term>Movable Sign</term><note>Aries, Cancer, Libra, or Capricorn; signs associated with change and movement</note> and its lord is also in a movable sign or Navamsha, and the lord of the ninth house is in a movable sign, he will travel to foreign lands. || 32 || These effects should be predicted when royal yogas are present, and not otherwise. # Chapter 9
## Sarvartha Chintamani

<margin>Sarvartha Chintamani Page 53</margin> ...that action [is ruined] when devoid of [the influence of] benefic planets. || 39 ||

When the Moon <note>original: "shashanke"</note> is in a cardinal house <term>Kendra: the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses, which are the pillars of a horoscope</term> and joined with Mars <note>original: "kshitisunu," literally 'son of the earth'</note>, or if any planet is situated in the eighth house <term>Randhra: the house of death and mysteries</term>, those who know the science <note>astrologers</note> declare death will occur through vehicles or mountains. However, if a waning Moon is situated in the fourth house || 40 || and the Sun is in the fourth house joined with a malefic aspect, the noble ones say the body will suffer from heat <note>likely referring to high fever or inflammatory diseases</note>. If the Moon is in the ninth house from the Sun, death in water is predicted for the father. || 41 ||

If the Sun and Moon are in Pisces <note>original: "jhashasthau"</note> and aspected by malefics, death in water is predicted for the father. If Saturn <note>original: "divaseshaputre," literally 'son of the lord of the day'</note> is joined with Mars and Rahu <note>original: "ahi," the serpent</note>, or if Saturn is in the fourth house, fear [of such a death] should be declared. || 42 ||

If Venus is in its sign of debilitation <note>Virgo</note> in the ninth house and joined with a malefic, the person becomes a striker of Brahmins <note>priests/scholars</note>; if also aspected by a malefic, he loses his ears <note>original: "vikarnata," possibly a metaphor for being deaf to wisdom or a literal physical deformity</note>. If Rahu <note>original: "phanindra," king of serpents</note> is in the tenth house <note>original: "mane"</note> joined with Mars, he becomes a killer of children. || 43 ||

If Jupiter or the Sun <note>original: "vasaranayake"</note> are in their signs of debilitation, situated in a cardinal house and joined with a malefic, he is a killer of children. If a cardinal house contains a malefic but is aspected by a benefic, and Venus is in the eighth house, he is a killer of cattle and deer. || 44 ||

If the Moon and Mercury <note>original: "shashankasaumyau"</note> are in the tenth house, aspected by malefics or joined with malefics, or if they are in their signs of debilitation and lack a benefic aspect, the person born will surely be a constant killer of birds. || 45 ||

If Jupiter is in the eighth house or in its sign of debilitation <note>Capricorn</note>, those who know the science predict death by the throat <note>original: "galantamrityum," perhaps choking or neck injury</note>. If the Moon is in the twelfth house, or in the seventh house with Venus, the left eye of the person born is destroyed. || 46 ||

If the Sun is in the eighth house or in a trine <term>Trikona: the 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</term>, there will be fear of the house collapsing. If Saturn or Ketu is there, then a lizard <note>original: "krikalasa"</note> will fall [upon the person]. || 47 ||

The experts declare a fall from one's lineage <note>loss of caste or social standing</note> if Rahu is there; if Mars is there, a fall from a tortoise <note>likely a specific architectural feature or a symbolic omen</note>. If Mercury <note>original: "somasute," son of the Moon</note> is there, a bite; if Venus, a fall while sleeping, or a fall of the wife. || 48 ||

If Saturn is there, the fall of men. One should declare these effects after considering the strength and weakness [of the planets]—

->Now, the following is described:<-

If the Sun is in the seventh house <note>the house of partnerships and marriage</note>, one has relations with a barren woman. If the Moon is in that house, the partner is of equal status. If Mars is there, one has relations with a woman during her menses or a barren woman. || 49 ||

If Mercury is in the seventh house, one visits a courtesan or a woman of lower status, such as a merchant's daughter. If Jupiter is in the seventh house, one has relations with the wife of a priest <note>original: "brahmana-bharyaya"</note>. If Venus is there, it is with a pregnant woman. || 50 ||

If Saturn, Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note>, or Ketu <note>the South Node of the Moon</note> are present, one visits a woman during her menses or one of a lower caste. If Rahu is in the seventh house, the wise say one has relations with a pregnant woman, a dark-complexioned woman, or a hunchback. || 51 ||

Such unions should be predicted especially when these planets are situated in the fourth house <note>the house of the home and comforts</note>. Based on the Sun and other planets being in the fourth house, one should describe the location of these unions. || 52 ||

The locations are: a forest, a house, an empty house, a place of recreation, a temple, a place near water, a stable for horses or elephants, a very difficult or fortified place, or a desolate land near water. || 53 ||

If the cardinal houses <note>the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</note> are occupied by malefic planets, the person born acts like an animal in union. If the cardinal and trine houses are joined with malefic planets, the person engages in sexual union like a beast. || 54 ||

If Mars is in the seventh house, the woman has small breasts; if Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu are there, she has long or sagging breasts. If the Sun is there, the breasts are firm and high; with the remaining planets <note>Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, or a strong Moon</note>, she has excellent and soft breasts. || 55 ||

If the Moon is waning or weak, the house is old and dilapidated; if the Moon is strong, the house is firm and new. If Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu are in a bad position, the house will certainly be damaged by fire. If the lords of the second and eleventh houses are friends with the lord of the first house, the person's wealth will be spent on priests and deities. || 56 ||

Thus, in this *Chintamani*, the determination of Royal Yogas <note>combinations for power and success</note> and the knowledge of their cancellations have been declared by the wise Venkatesha. || 57 ||

->Thus ends the Ninth Chapter of the *Sarvartha Chintamani*.<-

# Chapter 10
->S. Chi.<-

Some praise the planetary combinations <note>original: "yoga"</note> while others speak of the planetary periods <note>original: "dasha"</note>. Without these, the wise cannot truly know the span of a life. || 1 ||

The combinations for life span are of three types: short, medium, and long. Before thirty-two years is considered short life; beyond that is medium life. || 2 ||

Up to seventy years is considered medium, and beyond that is agreed to be long life. Those who know this science praise "excellent life" as being beyond a hundred years. || 3 ||

Until twelve years of age, the life span of living beings cannot be known with certainty. During this time, one should protect the child through prayers, offerings, and medical treatments. || 4 ||

Some die due to the faults of the parents, some due to childhood afflictions <note>original: "balagraha" - spirits or seizures believed to affect infants</note>, and others due to ill-omened planetary combinations. These are the three types of infant mortality. || 5 ||

Only after birth, when a child shows strong growth and nourishment, should one speak of the remaining life span according to the corresponding planetary combinations. || 6 ||

If the Sun is in an enemy sign at the time of birth, it indicates short life; if in a neutral sign, medium life; and if the Lord of the Ascendant is in a friendly sign, long life is declared. || 7 ||

For one born with a short-life combination, death may be predicted during the "Vipat" <note>the 3rd planetary period from birth</note> period. For one born with a medium-life combination, death occurs in the "Pratyari" <note>the 5th planetary period</note> period. || 8 ||

For those born with long-life combinations, death occurs in the "Vadha" <note>the 7th planetary period, literally meaning 'execution' or 'end'</note> period. Within these three general combinations, each is further divided into three types. || 9 ||

By the rule of "Movable and Fixed" signs, one determines long, medium, and short life. Having understood one of these, the knowledge of the life span is explained. || 10 ||

Short life is remembered as three-fold: short-short, short-medium, and short-full. Medium life is also three-fold: medium-short, medium-medium, and medium-full. || 11 ||

Long life is likewise three-fold: long-short, long-medium, and long-full. Thus, the determination of life spans is said to be of nine types. || 12 ||

The fifth period of Mars brings death; the sixth period of Jupiter; the fourth period of Saturn brings death; and the seventh period of Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note>. || 13 ||

<term>Ayuryoga</term>: Combinations for longevity.
<term>Balamrityu</term>: Infant mortality.
<term>Dirghayu</term>: Long life (70-100 years).
<term>Purnayu</term>: Full life span.
<term>Dasha</term>: Planetary periods or cycles of time.
<term>Vinirnaya</term>: Final determination or verdict.

The planetary period <note>original: "Dasha"</note> of the "Danger" star is difficult, as is the period of the "Enemy" star. The period of the Lord of the House of Death is likewise painful, and becomes truly wicked if aspected by malefic planets. || 14 ||

For one whose planets are in debilitation, in enemy signs, or otherwise bewildered, the periods of Danger, Enemy, and Death will bring about demise, especially if joined by malefic influences. || 15 ||

Those born during the junctions of zodiac signs <note>the transition point between two signs</note> are children whose lives are precarious; if these points are aspected by or joined with malefic planets, death is remembered as certain. || 16 ||

A mortal born during the <term>Gandaanta</term> <note>The "knotted end"—inauspicious junctions between water and fire signs</note> survives only through the spiritual merit of the father and mother. If such a one lives, he becomes a protector of the heavens, possessing many elephants and horses. || 17 ||

If the Sun and Moon are in the third house, or in the signs of cruel planets, or aspected by cruel planets, the wise say that man will suffer disease; for him, even three years of life are very difficult to attain. || 18 ||

If the Sun and Mars are in the seventh house from the Moon, or if Mars is in the rising sign, death occurs within ten days. This is also true if a terrible planet is in the seventh house from the rising <term>Drekkana</term> <note>A ten-degree subdivision of a zodiac sign, also known as a decan</note>. || 19 ||

When the waning Moon is situated in the <term>Vilagna</term> <note>The Ascendant or the point of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon</note>, it takes away life immediately. || 20 ||

If all planets are situated in <term>Apoklima</term> <note>The 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th houses, which are considered weak positions in Vedic astrology</note> and are devoid of strength, the life of that person is declared to be only two or six months. || 21 ||

If the <term>Vilagnadhipati</term> <note>The Lord of the Ascendant/Rising Sign</note> is in debilitation, in the house of death, or joined with the Sun, one should know that life will be lived with great hardship, and the person will be as if dead. || 21 || <note>The verse number 21 is repeated in the original manuscript.</note>

If the planet Ketu <note>The South Node of the Moon</note> rises in the East, followed by meteors, fire, and wind-storms, and if this occurs during a fierce Muhurta <note>A specific unit of time/auspicious moment</note>, the creature is abandoned by its life-breaths. || 22 ||

One born during a <term>Grahanaparivesha</term> <note>A planetary eclipse or a halo around the sun/moon</note> while malefic planets are in the rising sign and the Lord of the Ascendant is weak, lives for only three fortnights or three months. || 23 ||

He whose Lord of the Navamsha <note>the 1/9th divisional chart</note>, Lord of the Birth Sign, and Lord of the Ascendant have all set <note>become invisible due to proximity to the Sun</note>, his death will occur within a few days of birth. || 24 ||

The wise should predict death for one born during the <term>Sandhichatushtaya</term> <note>The four junctions of the day: dawn, noon, sunset, and midnight</note>.

## Chapter 10

If the Moon is joined with or aspected <note>aspected: in astrology, when one planet 'looks' at another from a specific distance, influencing its effects</note> by malefic planets <note>malefics: planets like Mars or Saturn that are traditionally thought to bring challenges</note>, and is not seen or joined by benefics <note>benefics: auspicious planets like Jupiter or Venus</note>, the child perishes quickly. || 25 || When Rahu <note>Rahu: the North Node of the Moon, often depicted as a shadow planet or dragon's head</note> is in a cardinal house <note>cardinal house: the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses, known as Kendras</note> and is joined or aspected by malefics, and not seen by benefics, the child meets a swift end. If a malefic is in a cardinal house, or if Saturn is in the Ascendant <note>Ascendant: the zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth, also called the Lagna</note> or a trine, while benefics are in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses, the child dies. || 26 ||

If the Moon is waning and situated in the Ascendant while being aspected by malefics, the child quickly goes to destruction. Even if Rahu is in its sign of exaltation <note>original: "uchcha-kshetra"</note> or in Aries, if it is joined by malefics, there is a loss of life. || 27 || If the Ascendant and the twelfth house are both occupied by malefics, or if the seventh and twelfth houses are so occupied, the child perishes in a moment. If malefics are in the eighth house from the Ascendant and the Moon is waning, the child may live only until the eighth year. || 28 ||

If the cardinal houses from the Moon are occupied by malefics, it is said the child goes to heaven within a year. If the lord of the birth sign is in the Ascendant joined with a cruel planet, and the lord of the eighth house is aspected by the Sun, excluding Jupiter's influence... || 29 || ...the child meets death in the sixth, twelfth, or eighth year, or at the junction <note>original: "sandhi"</note> of the signs. If the Moon is in the sixth or eighth house, or if it is waning in the twelfth house and joined by malefics... || 30 || ...but aspected by benefics, the child lives until the eighth year. If there is a mixture of malefics and benefics, it is called "middle strength" <note>original: "dalakhya"</note>. If Jupiter is in the Ascendant in Gemini or Libra, joined by Venus or Mercury... || 31 || ...but aspected by malefics or if those planets are in the house of death <note>the 8th house</note>, the child lives only until the eighth year. If the Moon is waning in the Ascendant and malefics are in the eighth or cardinal houses, or if the Moon is placed between malefics in the eighth, fourth, or seventh houses... || 32 || ...death occurs. This also happens if malefics are in the seventh or eighth houses from the Ascendant; the child may die along with the mother, provided they are not aspected by powerful benefics. || 33 ||

If the Moon is eclipsed by Rahu in the Ascendant, and Mars is in the eighth house joined by cruel planets, the child dies along with the mother. The same applies to the Sun as it does to the Moon; death comes quickly through weapons or a fall. || 34 ||

When the Sun <note>original: "dinapatau" - Lord of the Day</note> has set, and Saturn <note>original: "ravije" - son of the Sun</note> is in the Ascendant, or if Mars is in the eighth house <note>the house of death</note>, the child passes away in the third year. Even in this state, if the Moon <note>original: "himagau" - the cool-rayed one</note> is aspected by malefic planets and Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note> is in the eighth house, death occurs in the eighth year. || 35 ||

If Jupiter is in a sign owned by Mars <note>Aries or Scorpio</note> and situated in the eighth house, and is aspected by the Sun, Moon, Mars, and Saturn, and lacks the aspect of Venus <note>original: "bhārgava"</note>, the newborn reaches the other world <note>dies</note> within three years. || 36 ||

If a retrograde Saturn enters a sign of Mars and is placed in the eighth, sixth, or a cardinal house <note>1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th</note>, and is aspected by a strong Mars, the child lives for only two years. || 37 ||

If Saturn is in the seventh house or the Ascendant, and the Moon is in Scorpio at the time of birth, even if benefic planets are in cardinal houses, the death of the newborn is certain; this is **taught by the Greeks** <note>original: "yavanopadiṣṭa" - referring to the Yavanajataka or the influence of Hellenistic astrology on Indian systems</note>. || 38 ||

If Jupiter <note>the teacher of the gods</note> is in its sign of debilitation <note>Capricorn</note> or in a sign of Mars, and the birth occurs during any of the three types of "junctions" <note>sandhi - transitions between signs or lunar mansions</note>, the child meets death within a month. || 39 ||

Birth during the junction of lunar mansions <term>Nakshatra-sandhi: the transition point between specific constellations, considered spiritually volatile</term>, or the junction of lunar days <note>tithi</note> and zodiac signs, leads to the immediate death of the newborn. However, according to the sage Nandika, if Venus is present, the child may live. || 40 ||

If born on the sixth lunar day with the Sun or Mars in the Ascendant, or during a "knot-end" <term>Gandanta: the transition between a water sign and a fire sign</term>, or in a death-inflicting combination, Mars destroys the living being instantly, unless the child is aspected by Jupiter. || 41 ||

If Mars is in the Ascendant on a day when the Moon is waning <note>weak</note>, and the Lord of the Hour <term>Hora-swami: the planet ruling the specific hour of birth</term> is placed outside of the Ascendant or the cardinal houses, the one born reaches death very quickly. Saturn acts in the same manner as Mars in this configuration. || 42 ||

The Moon <note>original: "shītarashmi" - the cool-rayed one</note> situated in the 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th, 1st, or 8th houses and joined by malefic planets leads to death, provided it is not joined or aspected by the powerful Venus, Mercury <note>original: "shashiputra" - son of the Moon</note>, or Jupiter. || 43 ||

If the Moon is waning and malefic planets are in the Ascendant, the 7th, or the 8th house, the newborn infant goes to heaven <note>dies</note>.

If the lord of the rising sign <term>Lagna; the zodiac sign ascending on the eastern horizon at birth</term> and the lord of the sign occupied by the Moon are located in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses from the ascendant, and are joined with the Sun, the newborn will depart for the abode of Wealth <note>A metaphor for death/the afterlife</note> in twelve years, provided they are neither joined with nor aspected by <term>drishti; the "glance" or influence of a planet across the chart</term> benefic planets. || 65 ||

If the lord of the hour <term>Horadhipati; the planetary ruler of the specific hour of birth</term> is defeated by malefic planets in the seventh house, it certainly causes death. By multiplying the number of the sign by three, one can determine the year or month without doubt. || 66 ||

If the Sun, Moon, and Mars are joined in the fifth house <note>the house of children</note> and are not influenced by benefics, the newborn goes to the city of Yama <note>the God of Death</note> in the ninth year; of this there is no doubt. || 67 ||

When the lord of the ascendant is placed in the rising sign itself but is joined or aspected by all the malefic planets, the child will undoubtedly meet death in the fourth month. || 68 ||

If the Sun, as the lord of the Moon-sign, is joined with his son <note>the planet Saturn</note> and is placed in the eighth house from the ascendant, and is aspected by or situated with malefic planets, death occurs in the twelfth year. || 69 ||

If the sixth and eighth houses are occupied by malefics and are devoid of any aspect from benefic planets, and the lord of the ascendant is placed in an <term>Apoklima; the 3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th houses</term>, the person meets their end in the sixteenth year. || 70 ||

If the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the eighth house <note>the house of death</note> have exchanged their signs <note>Parivartana Yoga</note> and are not benefics, or if they are joined with the lord of speech <note>Jupiter</note> in the twelfth or sixth houses, death arrives in the eighteenth year. || 71 ||

When malefic planets are in the <term>Kendras; the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</term> along with the Moon, and are not aspected by benefic planets, or if the Moon is in the sixth or eighth house, the child born lives for only twenty years. || 72 ||

If the Sun is joined by Jupiter and placed in the ascendant in the sign of the Scorpion <note>Vrishchika</note>, and the lord of the eighth house is in a Kendra, death is certain in the twenty-second year. || 73 ||

If Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note> or the Moon is in the seventh or eighth house, and Jupiter is in the house of the ascendant, death will occur in the twenty-second year. || 74 ||

If the lord of the hour is placed between two malefic planets <note>Papa-kartari yoga</note> but is himself a benefic, and the birth occurs under the same birth-star as the father, the person goes to Yama <note>dies</note> in the twenty-fifth year. || 75 ||

If Saturn is in the ascendant in an enemy's sign, and the benefic planets are placed in <term>Apoklima</term> houses, death certainly occurs in either the twenty-sixth or twenty-seventh year. || 76 ||

### Regarding Long Life

All planets, whether auspicious or inauspicious, bestow long life when they are situated within the first six houses from the Ascendant. If they are joined in the latter half <note>houses 7 through 12</note>, the result for auspicious and inauspicious planets is the opposite. **27**

If the best of the benefic planets are in the first six houses from the Ascendant, all endowed with strength, and the malefics are elsewhere and radiant: the person is virtuous, well-behaved, wealthy, and goes to his death at eighty. **28**

When Mercury <note>original: "śaśisute" - son of the Moon</note> is in the Ascendant or a cardinal house, the Moon is in a trine, and Saturn is auspicious: one born thus is troubled by the gods and sages for years, but thereafter finds happiness. **29**

When all planets are located in odd-numbered zodiac signs <note>Aries, Gemini, etc.</note> along with a full Moon, and the Ascendant is an odd sign: he attains great fortune and a long life. **30**

# Now, the Combinations for a Sage (Muni Yoga)

When all the planets, from Jupiter and the Moon down to Saturn, are situated in fixed signs like Cancer <note>original: "karkyadi"; though Cancer is a movable sign, the text here refers to specific high-status placements</note> and are in their highest points of exaltation, the person born becomes equal to a sage. || 75 || When the auspicious planets from Saturn to Mars are in the Ascendant and other houses, and are endowed with the "Exalted Distinction" <term>Vaisheshikansha: a technical measure of planetary strength based on its position in multiple divisional charts</term>, those born are like the immortal gods. || 76 || A person lives for an entire eon <note>original: "akalpam"; a poetic exaggeration for extreme longevity</note> if Capricorn is the Ascendant and all planets from Mars to the Sun are present, provided Jupiter is in the third house and the birth occurs during the day. || 77 || If the Ascendant is at the end of Aries with Jupiter or Venus, and the Moon is in the middle degrees of Taurus or Sagittarius, and if Mars is in the "Throne" division <term>Simhasanansha: a specific strength where a planet occupies five favorable divisional charts</term>, the one born attains countless years through the power of mantras. || 78 || If the Sun is in a fixed sign joined with Mercury, the Moon is in Taurus, Venus is in Gemini, and Jupiter is in Cancer or the Ascendant while Saturn is in Libra, one attains the equality of a sage. || 79 || When the Moon is in the "Heavenly" division <term>Devalokansha: strength in seven divisional charts</term>, Mars is in the "Pigeon" division <term>Paravatansha: strength in six divisional charts</term>, and the Sun is in the "Throne" division in the Ascendant, the one born becomes equal to a sage. || 80 || With the Sun in the Aries Ascendant, Jupiter in the tenth house in its exaltation, and malefic planets in the third, sixth, or eleventh houses, the one born becomes equal to a sage. || 81 || In this *Chintamani* <note>The "Thought-Gem," referring to the title of the book</note>, I have declared the calculated lifespans for the wise; whatever was said by the ancients, all that has been presented by me now. || 82 ||

->Thus ends the twelfth chapter in the *Sarvartha Chintamani*. || 12 ||<-

# Now, the Radiant and Other States (Deeptadi)

The great sages say that the results of a birth, whether auspicious or inauspicious, are told according to the planetary periods <term>Dasha: time cycles in Vedic astrology ruled by specific planets</term>. Having extracted the essence of that, I shall now explain the distinctions of the periods in detail. || 1 || Radiant, Healthy, Happy, Peaceful, Deficient, Very Distressed, Mutilated, Cruel, and Angry—these are the nine states of a planet. || 2 || A planet in its exaltation is "Radiant" (Deepta); in its own sign, it is "Healthy" (Svastha)—
